description: This file defines the 'Dispatcher' class and 'ProtocolSession' class, handling protocol message dispatching, session management, and event emission for a browser automation framework, specifically related to Firefox Juggler protocol.

classes.name: Dispatcher
classes.description: Handles protocol message dispatching, session management, and event emission for the browser protocol.

classes.name: ProtocolSession
classes.description: Represents a protocol session, managing event handling and method dispatch within a session context.

methods.name: createSession
methods.description: Creates a new protocol session with a generated ID.

methods.name: _dispose
methods.description: Disposes of the dispatcher, cleaning up connections and sessions.

methods.name: _dispatch
methods.description: Handles incoming messages, dispatching them to appropriate session methods.

methods.name: _emitEvent
methods.description: Emits an event to the connection for a specific session.

methods.name: setHandler
methods.description: Sets a handler object for the session.

methods.name: _dispose
methods.description: Disposes of the session, cleaning up handler and dispatcher references.

methods.name: emitEvent
methods.description: Emits an event with parameters for the session.

methods.name: dispatch
methods.description: Dispatches a method call with parameters within the session.
